instruction: I am working on a presentation in LibreOffice Impress. Could you help me change the slide number color to blue? The current color makes it hard to distinguish.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide number color from default to blue in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the slide master XML to verify the page number placeholder color has been changed to blue (RGB with B > R+threshold and B > G+threshold). Similar complexity to original task, just different target color.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric function correctly targets page number placeholder using XPath './/p:sp[.//p:ph[@type="sldNum"]]//a:solidFill//a:srgbClr' (slides.py:46)
XPath specifically searches for shapes with placeholder type 'sldNum', which is the correct semantic approach for identifying slide number placeholders
Error handling present for missing page number placeholder (slides.py:49-50)
Color detection logic (is_blue with threshold=50) correctly checks if blue component is dominant: b > r + threshold and b > g + threshold (slides.py:22-24)
Parameter handling is correct - function receives 'rules' dict directly and accesses 'rules["color"]' properly (slides.py:5, 16)
Postconfig correctly saves file with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure changes are persisted
Coverage is complete - evaluator fully checks the instruction requirement (slide number color = blue)
Previous issues with hardcoded positional indexing have been fixed - now uses semantic targeting by placeholder type attribute
